<hr>

I create data-driven projects and stories focused on economic development and climate. 

currently:
: I'm a Senior Data Investigator at [Global Witness](https://globalwitness.org/en/){target="_blank"} working on forests, finance, and supply chains. I'm based in the UK. 

previously: 
: I was a consultant at the [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/unit-dec/research){target="_blank"} working on development and trade policy research, and a research specialist at [Princeton University](https://esoc.princeton.edu){target="_blank"} analyzing conflict and misinformation. 

<hr>

tools: 
: R, Python, STATA (in a past life 😊), Datawrapper, LLMs

skills:
: data analysis, visualization, geospatial analysis, econometrics, causal inference, web scraping

<hr>

background:
: MA in Economics (2019) and BA in Economics and Geography (2018) from McGill University. Grew up in 6 countries. Philippine and Canadian dual citizen.

personally:
: I enjoy art, culture, fashion, geography, reading, gaming, language learning
